Subject: Acme — audit logging & SOC 2 discovery (post-call recap)

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

What we covered:
- Redwood audit logging basics: admin activity logs, API request/response logs, system events (deploys, config changes).
- Exportability: logs can be exported to customer-owned S3/Cloud Storage (parquet/csv), or pushed to SIEMs via webhook/forwarder.
- Retention & immutability: configurable retention policies; we support write-once export workflows and signed, time-stamped exports for compliance needs.
- SOC 2 status & questionnaire: marissa shared that Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report available via secure link and offered to initiate the vendor security questionnaire.

Immediate next steps (agreed):
1) I will send our security overview PDF and the vendor security questionnaire (attached).
2) Aditya / Dev: can you confirm the default retention windows for admin vs API logs and note whether we have an immutable export path (WORM) or signed export workflow? Goal: get firm answers for Acme by EOD Monday.
3) Alex: please confirm who on your side will own the questionnaire (name + email) and any deadline for the procurement team.

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf, Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Thanks Marissa — very helpful recap. Priya and I will own the questionnaire. Priya (cc'd) will coordinate with our procurement and security teams. Two quick follow-ups from our side:

1) Immutability: Can you confirm whether exported logs are tamper-evident/signed? Is there a WORM option for S3 exports?
2) API logs: what is the default retention for request/response logs and how long are admin activity logs kept? We will likely need 1 year for API logs and 3 years for admin audit logs for our internal policy.

If you can get those answers + the SOC 2 report link that would help us move to procurement review this week.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Priya Singh <priya.s@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme — audit logging & SOC 2 discovery (post-call recap)

Alex / Priya —

Thanks — Priya, great to meet you via email.

Quick answers (high level):
- SOC 2: Redwood maintains a current SOC 2 Type II report. We will share the secure report link (read-only) via a gated access flow; I will send that to you in a separate, secure message today.
- Immutability / signed exports: We offer time-stamped, signed export bundles for audit purposes. Exports can be written to customer-owned S3 with Object Lock (WORM) enabled; alternatively we can provide signed manifests and SHA256 checksums for each export bundle if you prefer not to manage Object Lock.
- Retention defaults: API request/response logs are retained 90 days by default (configurable). Admin activity logs are retained 365 days by default for hosted accounts. For Dedicated/Private deployments we support longer configurable retention (e.g., 3+ years) and can help with plan details.

Next steps (updated):
- I attached the Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx. Please fill sections 1–3 (security program, encryption, audit/logging) and route back.
- Aditya / Dev: can you confirm (a) admin log retention configurable to 3 years for Dedicated customers, (b) whether we have a documented signed-export manifest workflow and an example SHA256 manifest we can share? If you can drop answers in-line in the questionnaire or send bullet answers, that'd be ideal.
- I'll follow up with the SOC 2 secure link via separate channel.

Target: get questionnaire back by EOD Thursday so procurement can start review next week.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachments: Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Acme questionnaire — audit logging answers (need quick confirmation)

Team —

Following up to capture the exact answers for Acme (they asked for signed exports, immutability, and multi-year retention). Can you confirm the following so I can populate the questionnaire? Please respond inline if possible.

Q1) Is admin audit log retention configurable to 3 years for Dedicated customers? If yes, any cost/impact notes?
A1) 

Q2) Do we support WORM/Object Lock when exporting to customer S3? If not directly, do we have a recommended export pattern and do we provide signed manifests / SHA256 checksums?
A2) 

Q3) API request/response default retention is 90 days — can we extend to 12 months for Acme on Dedicated? Any storage/ingress considerations?
A3) 

Q4) Example manifest: can you produce a short example SHA256 manifest (one-liner) or point me to an internal doc I can share?
A4) 

Timing: Acme wants answers back by EOD Thursday. If you can't complete by then, let me know what you can provide and I will share partial answers. I'll also need an example export policy snippet we can include in the questionnaire.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

(On a related note, we should flag this as a potential Dedicated deal — request that Solutions Eng queue a readiness check if they answer 'yes' to 3-year retention and Object Lock support.)
